description: Which BT ids does LIKE match when the operand is not Text: Long ('1*', and a numeric pattern 5), Double ('1.*'), Date (a leading month '1/*' and '2024*', CStr, Format), Yes/No ('-*' and 'T*'), Memo ('a*' and '*b*'), and a Null pattern over a Long; with error numbers where refused?
